name: Spherical Coordinate Ray-Casting Volume Rendering
definition: A ray-casting method to visualize 3D power volumetric data of EME on a globe, handling non-regular grid data organized in spherical coordinates.
summary: Spherical Coordinate Ray-Casting Volume Rendering visualizes 3D volumetric data on non-regular spherical grids by projecting rays through a spherical bounding box and converting coordinates in the fragment shader.
